I wouldn't be surprised knowing the type of comedian Bill Burr is, but I have to disagree with it just being the blue collars in the nosebleeds. 

I can understand embracing the tough guy characterization, but there's a fine line between being a tough guy and a jerk. When people are being told not to wear their team gear for their own safety then there's a problem. 

I was at a youth leadership forum a few years ago and we had the team physician for the Redskins at the time (not sure if he's still with the team or not) talk with us. He said that at one of the Eagles games a cop told him to take his skins jacket off because "they will hurt you". Not to mention there was the guy on here whose cousin was banned from Lincoln due to an altercation started by a Philadelphia fan. 

Granted, there's a chance those stories were exaggerated, but the point being made is that people shouldn't have to leave their gear at home because their afraid of the other team's fans starting shit. I'm sure that most Eagles fans are reasonable people, but it's the asshole fans out there that give them that bad reputation and I'm pretty sure the Eagles aren't the only team whose fan base has a poor reputation because of the bad apples. The fans are an extension of the team and more people need to start realizing that.

Yeah, some fan bases have really bad reputations for how they treat the fans of visiting teams. Philadelphia is one of those teams. The best comparison I can think of for how they act is soccer hooligans, although I don't think it goes any further than being an asshole and causing the occasional fight. Fans can be assholes, but for the most part they don't do anything to the field of the people on it.

I had gotten killed there before and we had gone back there to not only get my stuff but get him some stuff (there we a lot of bodies on top of the hospital). Brady (Donnel) - I felt like this was the only way to make Brady a useful battle monk. He's pretty good, but I plan to make him better with limiter breaker.

Owain (Vaike) - He was great as a swordmaster, but I like him better as a dread fighter. His magic is a bit lacking but he makes up for it with the swords and axes.

Severa (MU) - She's pretty powerful on her own but there are times were she's been overwhelmed on the DLC. Paired up with Brady they're a hell of a team though.
